name: Enchiladas Potosinas

ingredients.name: fresh queso fresco or paneer, crumbled

steps: Soak the chillies in hot water for 15 minutes. Blend with 150 ml of their soaking water and strain to make a smooth red puree.
Knead masa harina with the chilli puree, remaining warm water and 6 g salt until soft and pliable. Cover and rest 15 minutes; mix the cheese with onion.
Divide into 12 balls. Press each between sheets of plastic to a small tortilla, put 1 tablespoon filling in the centre, fold into a half-moon and seal the edges.
Cook on a medium-hot dry griddle for 2 minutes per side. Brush with oil and cook once more until lightly crisp; serve warm.
tips: Keep the masa covered while shaping so the edges seal without cracking.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
